name: primitives-animate-slot
title: Animate Slot
blurb: Applies motion animations to child elements while preserving their native HTML…
description: A slot component that wraps child elements and applies motion animation props without changing the child's element type. Merges className and refs transparently.
use_when: Animating child components without adding wrapper divs or replacing the child's HTML element type.
avoid_when: When explicit control over the rendered element type is required.
a11y: Preserves child element semantics and accessibility; animations are purely visual.
